metadata.title: Groupicorn Kansas IOP/PHP research directory

metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Current provider, state, and accreditation sources support IOP/PHP location records in Lawrence, the Kansas City metro, and Wichita; additional leads remain in the verification queue until exact-site evidence and logo provenance are checked.
